reference.question: In \(\triangle ABC\), \(\angle A=40^\circ\), and \(O\) is its circumcenter. Find the measure of \(\angle OBC\) (in degrees).
reference.solution:
Method 1: Central angle and equal radii

\(\angle BOC=2\angle A=80^\circ\). Also, \(OB=OC\), so \(\angle OBC=(180^\circ-80^\circ)/2=50^\circ\).
